backup.readme:
This folder is a backup made with reset_back_system.

To restore: after the reset open reset_back_system, choose 'Restore' and point it to this folder.

WARNING: this backup may contain Wi-Fi passwords, SSH keys or BitLocker keys. Keep it somewhere safe and do not share it.

https://github.com/OmerYurekli05/reset_back_system
gui.subtitle: Choose what to back up before a reset, then restore everything in the right order afterwards.
gui.admin.no: Not administrator: some items are disabled
gui.profile.tip: Save the selected items to a file and reuse them later
gui.dryrun.tip: Shows what would happen without touching anything
gui.overwrite.tip: When off, files that already exist on the new system are kept
gui.empty.restore:
Choose the backup folder and press 'Read backup'.
reset_back_system backups are folders named 'ResetBack-date'.
gui.scanning: Scanning the computer for things to back up...
gui.found: {0} items found. Choose what you want to back up.
gui.err.target: Choose where to save the backup.
gui.warn.systemdrive:
The backup will be saved on the system drive (C:) that is about to be reset. It will be DELETED by the reset.

Continue anyway? (An external drive or another disk such as D: is recommended.)
gui.warn.sensitive:
Your selection contains sensitive data (Wi-Fi passwords, SSH/VPN keys, BitLocker key).

Keep the backup somewhere safe and do not share it.
gui.ask.restore: {0} items will be restored to this computer. Continue?
gui.ask.closeapps:
These programs are running: {0}

Close them so their settings are copied correctly.
Yes = I closed them, check again
No = continue anyway
Cancel = stop
gui.ask.quit: Work is still running. Close anyway?
item.registry.name: Registry snapshot (reference)
item.registry.desc: Exports HKCU (and HKLM\SOFTWARE when admin). Kept only to look up a setting, never imported automatically.
registry.readme:
These .reg files are for reference only. Open them in Notepad to look up a setting.
Do NOT double-click to import a whole file: it can break a fresh Windows install.
